name: Dealers Trade v 7.74 MACD
summary: This EA trades based on MACD signal crossovers and momentum shifts, entering positions when the MACD histogram crosses the signal line with configurable filters for trend confirmation. It includes position management features such as trailing stops, break-even logic, and partial close capabilities to lock in profits.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD信号线交叉和动量变化进行交易，当MACD柱状图穿越信号线时结合可配置的趋势确认过滤器开仓。它包含移动止损、保本逻辑和部分平仓等仓位管理功能以锁定利润。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是MACD动量交易，利用MACD指标的主线与信号线交叉作为入场信号，当MACD柱状图从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空。入场条件除了MACD交叉外，还可能包含趋势方向过滤和波动率过滤，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、移动止损和保本止损，当价格朝有利方向移动一定点数后触发保本或移动止损跟随。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式，支持加仓和减仓操作。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损限制，但具体参数需根据用户配置而定。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is MACD momentum trading, using the crossover of the MACD main line and signal line as entry signals — going long when the MACD histogram crosses from negative to positive, and going short when it crosses from positive to negative. Entry conditions may include additional trend direction and volatility filters beyond the MACD crossover to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets. Exit conditions consist of fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, trailing stops, and break-even logic that activates once price moves a configured number of points in the favorable direction. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot calculation, and supports both position addition and partial close operations. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily drawdown caps, though specific values depend on user configuration parameters.
pros: MACD是经典成熟指标，信号逻辑清晰易懂，适合中长期趋势交易
具备完善的仓位管理功能，包括移动止损和保本止损，有效保护利润
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据不同品种和周期灵活调整策略参数
pros_en: MACD is a well-established classic indicator with clear signal logic suitable for medium-to-long-term trend trading
Comprehensive position management features including trailing stop and break-even logic effectively protect profits
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to flexibly adjust strategy for different instruments and timeframes
cons: MACD作为滞后指标，在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一周期MACD信号可靠性有限
未集成点差过滤和新闻事件过滤，在市场波动剧烈时可能不利入场
cons_en: MACD as a lagging indicator tends to generate false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, reducing reliability of single-timeframe MACD signals
No integrated spread filter or news event filter, potentially entering during unfavorable high-volatility conditions
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势确认，例如在H4确认趋势方向后仅在M15/M30寻找入场信号
加入点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免在交易成本过高或市场剧烈波动时开仓
引入自适应止损机制，根据ATR动态调整止损距离而非使用固定点数
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation, e.g., confirm trend direction on H4 then seek entry signals on M15/M30
Incorporate spread and volatility filters to avoid entering when trading costs are too high or markets are highly volatile
Introduce adaptive stop-loss using ATR-based dynamic stop distances instead of fixed pip values

risk_points: MACD滞后性在震荡市中可能产生连续虚假信号
固定止损可能不适应不同市场波动环境
缺乏多时间框架确认增加了逆势交易风险
risk_points_en: MACD lagging nature may produce consecutive false signals in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to varying market volatility conditions
Lack of multi-timeframe confirmation increases risk of counter-trend entries

summary_en: This EA trades based on MACD signal crossovers and momentum shifts, entering positions when the MACD histogram crosses the signal line with configurable filters for trend confirmation. It includes position management features such as trailing stops, break-even logic, and partial close capabilities to lock in profits.
